shortDescription: Slovenia 10 Year Government Bond Yield increased to 3.97%, the highest since April 2014.Over the past 4 weeks, Slovenia 10Y Bond Yield gained 30.70 basis points, and in the last 12 months, it increased 85.00 basis points.
